source: On a weekday a pending handoff may resume only after a matching signed receipt arrives. On a weekend it remains pending until Monday. The separate operations annex is unavailable.

cases.reason: The weekday rule permits resumption after a matching signed receipt arrives, while weekend handoffs wait until Monday.
The separate operations annex requires the shift lead to phone the author before a handoff.
A matching signed receipt permits resumption on any day of the week.
For weekends, the policy says that the handoff ‘remains pending until Monday’.
On weekdays, the policy instructs the worker to resume immediately and obtain the matching receipt afterward.
